rationale.ai-review: AI formalizes decisions into test suites to validate the implementation
rationale.rules-based-checks: automatically runs the generated test suites to validate the code
rationale.quality-debt: quantifies cognitive debt via mental model disagreement with the code
rationale.oversight-explanation: test summaries and code references help users validate agent output
rationale.built-system: Aporia implemented as a VS Code extension and evaluated
rationale.agentic: studies autonomous coding agents modifying codebases at artifact granularity
rationale.steering: Decision Bank directly shapes the agent's code generation process
rationale.risk-quality: addresses cognitive debt and programmers' mental models of their code
rationale.risk-overreliance: mitigates vibe coding where users blindly cede decision-making authority
rationale.method-experiment: within-subjects user study with 14 programmers completing tasks
